name: craft-fortrabbit
description: fortrabbit (fortrabbit.com): managed PHP hosting with a Craft CMS software template. Covers git push-to-deploy through the fortrabbit GitHub App, the template's build and post-deploy commands, the merge deployment strategy with the /config/project replace pattern, the deploy file (.fortrabbit/deploy.yml) and its replace-by-default trap, CRAFT_* ENV vars mapped from FORTRABBIT_DB_*, production settings (admin changes and updates off), persistent storage for asset volumes and rsync sync, MySQL over an SSH tunnel, the queue and image transforms in a worker job, crons, platform limits (no root, no sendmail), and DDEV local development.
